verdict.rationale: Context.dev's extract-structured-data guide explicitly lets developers provide a JSON Schema (not selectors) and have the system crawl relevant pages, ground results, and return matching JSON, with a dedicated API endpoint for this purpose. This is corroborated by the async batch/extraction endpoints and SDK guides showing structured extraction usage. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of extraction accuracy/quality versus selector-based scraping, and no third-party review specifically validating natural-language-to-schema extraction fidelity.
